data.narrative:
Synchron is a Series D biotech company founded by Tom Oxley and Rahul Sharma that has raised $200M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 8 private companies and 3 public comparables in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Abridge ($5.3B, Series E), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B, Series C).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x multiplier to the $200M total raised as a proxy baseline, implying $300M. Peer-median anchoring uses the 4-company median valuation of $4.5B, with a range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B across the comparable set. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue for the target. The 3 public biotech peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) carry a median P/S multiple of 5.6x but lack applicability without target revenue.

The triangulated range is $255M (low) to $5.2B (high), with a median of $2.4B. The wide spread reflects stage and maturity differences within the peer cohort; Synchron's Series D position sits between earlier-stage Series C peers and more mature Series E companies. Key uncertainties include the company's revenue trajectory and clinical/regulatory progress relative to stage peers, both of which would materially inform positioning within the derived range.
